linus: Hey team — hit a regression on canary (commit abc123). 1F1B p50 is ~18% higher with microbatch=4 on 8xA100. KV cache hitrate looks unchanged, but PP bubble % jumped. I attached a short perf trace.

maya: Can you paste the flamegraphs or the top hotspots? which kernel is stalling?

linus: Flame shows long waits in NCCL allreduce during backward matmul steps. Looks like comm/compute overlap failed for several microbatches. Also noticed kernel-selector picked the fallback cuBLAS path for some GEMM shapes (seq_len > 1024) instead of the fused kernel we used previously. Suspect a selector cost change + schedule mismatch.

linus: Quick repro command I used:
```
./tools/run_prof.sh --trace --model=redwood_v2 --pp=4 --microbatch=4 --devices=8 --out=/tmp/trace-2090012345.json
```

perf-bot: Trace uploaded: /artifacts/2090012345/trace-2090012345.json — Top blockers: NCCL allreduce wait (23% GPU1), synchronous memcpy before allreduce (7%), kernel dispatch stall (5%). KV cache commit point aligned with sync.

ara: Two quick ideas: 1) flip `schedule.force_overlap=true` and rerun to see if overlap policy helps, 2) force kernel hint `CUDA_KERNEL_HINT=prefer_fp16` to bias selector back to fused path and compare.

toni: Did a fast run with `schedule.force_overlap=true` + microbatch=4 — p50 improved ~10% but still worse than baseline. nvprof shows small host->device memcpy happening just before allreduce start (maybe barrier in rendezvous).

linus: Plan: 1) run microbatch sweep (2,4,8) with kernel-probe enabled to capture selected kernels per step, 2) try async-allreduce variant (defer reduce commit) in a branch, 3) add short regression test in perf-suite to catch kernel selection flips for seq_len around 1k–1.3k.

maya: I'll own the microbatch sweep and kernel-probe collection tomorrow and will post the heatmaps. Also +1 on adding a unit perf test that asserts kernel family for synthetic shapes.

linus: SG. For the kernel-probe run use:
```
KERNEL_PROBE=1 ./tools/run_prof.sh --trace --model=redwood_v2 --seq_len=1280 --pp=4 --microbatch=$MB --out=/tmp/kprobe-$MB.json
```

linus: After we have traces, I can run a quick allreduce-only sim to validate whether NCCL scheduling is the root cause. If it's kernel selector drift, we'll revert the selector change and ship a hotfix.

maya: :thumbsup: adding test plan to the ticket now. Ping me if you want me to try the async reduce branch as well.
